articles.summary: Ashesi University is pleased to welcome Dr. Yaw Bediako as the Dean of Research and Innovation. In this role, he will provide strategic leadership to advance our research initiatives, foster innovation across various academic disciplines, and strengthen partnerships that support Ashesi’s mission. articles.title: Dr. Yaw Bediako Joins Ashesi as Dean of Research and Innovation
